data.titulo: Ye nyɔfela ƒe Israel ƒe Babilon nududzɔ
data.contenido:
Saul va zu Israel-fia gbãtɔ. Gake Yehowa gbee, eye wòtia Dawid be wòaɖu fia ɖe eteƒe. Míasrɔ̃ nu geɖe tso Dawid ŋuti. Esi wònye ɖevi la, ewɔ aʋa kple Goliat, ame dzɔtsu la. Emegbe la, esi le Fia Saul, ŋuʋãla la nu. Eye Abigail dzetugbee la xe mɔ nɛ be mewɔ bometsinu o.

Emegbe la, míasrɔ̃ nu geɖe le Dawid ƒe vi Salomo, amesi xɔ ɖe Dawid teƒe abe Israel-fia ene la ŋuti. Israel-fia gbãtɔ etɔ̃awo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖu fia hena ƒe 40. Le Salomo ƒe ku megbe la, woma Israel ɖe fiaɖuƒe eve me, anyiehe kple dziehe fiaɖuƒe.

To 10 ƒe dziehe fiaɖuƒe la nɔ anyi ƒe 257 hafi Asiriatɔwo va tsrɔ̃e. Ƒe 133 megbe la, wotsrɔ̃ to eve ƒe anyiehe fiaɖuƒe la hã. Fifia ya la, woɖe aboyo Israel-viwo yi ɖe Babilon. Eyata Akpa ENELIA kpe ƒe 510 ƒe ŋutinya ɖo, ɣeyiɣi, sia me nukunu geɖe dzɔ.

KPƆ Samuel ɖa, ele ami kɔm ɖe tame na ŋutsu la. Aleae wowɔna na ame atsɔ fiae be wotiae be wòanye fia. Yehowae gblɔ na Samuel be wòakɔ ami ɖe Saul ƒe tame. Enye ami tɔxɛ aɖe, si ʋẽna lilili.

Saul mesusui be yedze be yeanye fia o. Egblɔ na Samuel be: ‘Benyamin-ƒome, si nye suetɔ kekeake le Israel la mee metso. Nukatae nèbe yeaɖo fiam?’ Yehowa lɔ̃ Saul, elabena mewɔ eɖokui amegã kple ame ŋkutae o. Ematae wòtiae be wòanye fia ɖo.

Gake Saul menye ame dahe alo ame kpui o. Kesinɔtɔwo ƒe ƒome mee wòtso, eye wònye ame dzeɖekɛ kɔkɔ aɖe. Ekɔ wu ame kɔkɔtɔ, si le Israel la kple afɔ ɖeka! Saul ƒua du sesĩe, eye wònye ame sesẽ hã. Ameawo kpɔ dzidzɔ be Yehowa tia Saul be wòanye fia. Wo katã te ɣlidodo be: ‘Fia nanɔ agbe tegbee!’

Ŋusẽ gale Israel ƒe futɔwo ŋu kokoko. Wogale fu ɖem na Israel-viwo ŋutɔ. Esi woɖo fia Saul teti ko la, Amonitɔwo va aʋa wɔ ge kpli wo. Gake Saul ƒo aʋawɔlawo nu ƒu, eye woɖu Amonitɔwo dzi. Esia do dzidzɔ na ameawo be Saul nye fia.

Esi ƒeawo va nɔ yiyim la, Saul nɔ ŋgɔ na Israel-viwo woɖu woƒe futɔ geɖewo dzi. Viŋutsuvi kalẽtɔ aɖe, si ŋkɔe nye Yonatan la nɔ Saul si. Yonatan hã kpe ɖe Israel ŋu woɖu aʋa geɖe dzi. Filistitɔwo ganye Israel-viwo ƒe futɔ vɔ̃ɖitɔ. Gbeɖeka la, Filistitɔ akpe geɖewo va aʋa wɔ ge kple Israel-viwo.

Samuel gblɔ na Saul be wòalala vaseɖe esime yeava sa vɔ na Yehowa. Gake Samuel meva kaba o. Saul le vɔvɔ̃m be Filistitɔwo aho aʋa ɖe yewo ŋu, eyata eya ŋutɔ dze ŋgɔ yi ɖasa vɔ la. Esi Samuel va la, egblɔ na Saul be ewɔ tosẽnu. Egblɔ na Saul be: ‘Yehowa atia ame bubu be wòanye fia ɖe Israel dzi.’

Emegbe la, Saul gasẽ to ake. Eyata Samuel gblɔ nɛ be: ‘Toɖoɖo Yehowa nyo wu alẽ nyuitɔ, si woatsɔ nɛ. Esi mèɖo to Yehowa o ta la, Yehowa magana nànye fia na Israel o.’

Míate ŋu asrɔ̃ nu nyui aɖe tso esia me. Efia alesi wòle vevie be woaɖo to Yehowa ɣesiaɣi la. Egafia hã be ame nyui abe alesi Saul nɔ tsã ene la ate ŋu atrɔ azu ame gbegblẽ. Ðe míedi be míazu ame gbegblẽwoa?Samuel I, ta 9 vaseɖe 11; 13:5-14; 14:47-52; 15:1-35;  Samuel II, 1:23. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

ÈKPƆ nusi dzɔa? Ðevi la xɔ alẽvi la le sisiblisi la si. Sisiblisi la va kɔ alẽvi la heyi ɖuɖu ge. Ðevi la ƒu du kplɔ wo ɖo heɖe alẽvi la le sisiblisi la ƒe nu me. Esi sisiblisi la tsi tre la, ŋutsuvi la vãe goŋgoŋ hexlãe ɖi wòku! Ɣebubuɣi la, exɔ alẽawo dometɔ ɖeka le dzata aɖe si. Ðe ɖevi ma mesesẽ ŋutɔ oa? Ènya amesi wònyea?

Eyae nye Dawid, ɖevi la. Ele Betlexem-du me. Tɔgbuia enye Obed, Rut kple Boaz ƒe viŋutsu la. Èɖo ŋku wo dzia? Eye Dawid fofo ŋkɔe nye Isai. Dawid kplɔna fofoa ƒe alẽwo. Esi Yehowa tia Saul be wòanye fia ƒe 10 megbee wodzi Dawid.

Ɣeyiɣi la de esime Yehowa gblɔ na Samuel be: ‘Tsɔ ami tɔxɛ aɖe, eye nàyi Isai ƒeme le Betlexem. Metia viawo dometɔ ɖeka be wòanye fia.’ Esi Samuel kpɔ Isai-vi ŋutsuvi tsitsitɔ Eliab la, egblɔ na eɖokui be: ‘Amesia kokokoe Yehowa tia.’ Gake Yehowa gblɔ nɛ be: ‘Mègakpɔ eƒe kɔkɔme kple ɖekadzedze o. Menye eyae metia be wòanye fia o.’

Eye Isai yɔ viaŋutsuvi Abinadab va Samuel gbɔe. Gake Samuel gblɔ be: ‘Ao, menye eya hãe Yehowa tia o.’ Emegbe la, Isai kplɔ viaŋutsuvi Sama hã vɛ. Samuel gblɔ be: ‘Ao, Yehowa metia eya hã o.’ Isai kplɔ viaŋutsuvi adre va Samuel gbɔ, gake Yehowa metia wo dometɔ aɖeke o. Samuel bia be: ‘Ŋutsuviawo katãe nye esia?’

Isai ɖo ŋu be: ‘Esusɔ ɖevitɔ kekeake. Gake eyi alẽkplɔƒe.’ Esi wokplɔ Dawid vɛ la, Samuel kpɔ be edze ɖeka ŋutɔ. Yehowa gblɔ be: ‘Amesiae. Kɔ ami la ɖe edzi.’ Eye Samuel wɔe nenema. Ɣeyiɣi aɖo, esime Dawid ava zu Israel-fia.Samuel I, 17:34, 35; 16:1-13. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

FILISTITƆWO gava aʋa wɔ ge kple Israel. Fifia Dawid nɔviŋutsu tsitsi etɔ̃awo le Saul ƒe aʋawɔlawo dome. Eyata Isai gblɔ na Dawid gbeɖeka bena: ‘Tsɔ bli kple abolo yi na nɔviwòwo. Nàkpɔ alesi wole la ɖa.’

Esi Dawid ɖo aʋasaɖa la me la, eƒu du yi asaɖa la me yi nɔviawo di ge. Filistitɔ triakɔ Goliat do va alɔme ɖe ge le Israel-viwo ŋu. Enɔ esia wɔwɔ dzi ŋdi sia ŋdi kple ɣetrɔ sia ɣetrɔ hena ŋkeke 40. Enɔ ɣli dom be: ‘Mitia mia dometɔ ɖeka wòawɔ aʋa kplim. Ne eɖu dzinye hewum la, míanye miaƒe kluviwo. Ke ne meɖu edzi hewui la, mianye míaƒe kluviwo. Mitia ame ɖeka be wòawɔ aʋa kplim kpɔ.’ Dawid bia aʋawɔla aɖewo be: ‘Ne ame aɖe wu Filistitɔ sia heɖe Israel-viwo tso ŋukpe sia me la, nukae wòaxɔ?’

Aʋawɔla la gblɔ be: ‘Saul ana kesinɔnu geɖee. Eye wòatsɔ eya ŋutɔ vianyɔnuvi nɛ wòaɖe.’

Gake Israel-viwo katã le Goliat vɔ̃m, elabena edzɔ atsu ŋutɔ. Ekɔ wu afɔ 9 (abe meta 3 ene), eye aʋawɔla bubu lé akpoxɔnu ɖe asi nɛ.

Aʋawɔla aɖewo yi ɖagblɔ na Fia Saul be Dawid di be yeawɔ aʋa kple Goliat. Gake Saul gblɔ na Dawid be: ‘Màte ŋu awɔ aʋa kple Filistitɔ sia o. Ðevi ko nènye, eye eya nye aʋawɔla tso ɖevime ke.’ Dawid ɖo ŋu be: ‘Mewu sisiblisi kple dzata hexɔ fofonye ƒe alẽwo le wo si. Eyata Filistitɔ sia azu abe wo dometɔ ɖeka ene. Yehowa akpe ɖe ŋunye.’ Eyata Saul gblɔ be: ‘Heyi, eye Yehowa nanɔ anyi kpli wò.’

Dawid yi tɔ aɖe to hefɔ kpe zɔzrɔ̃e atɔ̃ de eƒe kotoku me. Azɔ etsɔ eƒe akafo heyi kalẽtɔ la kpe ge. Esi Goliat kpɔe la, ewɔ nuku nɛ. Ebu be yeate ŋu awu Dawid bɔbɔe.

Goliat gblɔ be: ‘Te va gbɔnye ko, eye matsɔ wò lã na xeviwo kple gbemelãwo woaɖu.’ Gake Dawid gblɔ be: ‘Wòa egbɔna gbɔnye kple akplɔ, yi kple tunuhlo, gake nye ya megbɔna gbɔwò kple Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ. Egbea la, Yehowa atsɔ wò ade asi nam, eye mawu wò aƒu anyi.’

Tete Dawid ƒu du ɖo ta Goliat gbɔ. Etsɔ kpe le eƒe kotoku me, tsɔe de eƒe akafo me heda kple eƒe ŋusẽ katã. Kpe la zɔ tẽ heŋɔ Goliat ƒe ta ge ɖe eme, eye wòdze anyi gbloo heku! Esi Filistitɔwo kpɔ be yewoƒe kalẽtɔ la dze anyi la, wo katã wotrɔ hesi. Israel-viwo ti wo yome, eye woɖu aʋa la dzi. Samuel I, 17:1-54. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

data.titulo: Nu Si Ta Wòle Be David Nasi
data.contenido:
ESI Dawid wu Goliat megbe la, Israel ƒe aʋafia Abner kplɔe va Saul gbɔe. Saul kpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Dawid ŋu ŋutɔ. Etsɔe ɖo fiae ɖe eƒe aʋawɔlawo nu, eye wokplɔe wòva le fia ƒe aƒeme.

Emegbe esi aʋawɔlawo trɔ tso Filistitɔwo wuƒe gbɔna la, nyɔnuwo nɔ ha dzim be: ‘Saul wu akpe, ke Dawid wu akpe nane.’ Esia na Saul ʋã ŋu, elabena wode bubu geɖe Dawid ŋu wu Saul. Gake Saul ƒe vi Yonatan meʋã ŋui o. Elɔ̃ Dawid ŋutɔ, eye Dawid hã lɔ̃ Yonatan. Eyata wo kple evea do ŋugbe na wo nɔewo be yewoanye xɔlɔ̃wo ɖaa. Dawid nye kasaŋku ƒola nyui aɖe, eye ha, siwo wòƒona la dzɔa dzi na Saul ŋutɔ. Gake gbeɖeka la, Saul ƒe ŋuʋaʋã la na wòwɔ nu dziŋɔ aɖe. Esi Dawid nɔ kasaŋku ƒom la, Saul tsɔ eƒe akplɔ hedae, egblɔ be: ‘Matɔ Dawid amimi ɖe gli ŋu!’ Gake Dawid de axae, eye akplɔ la dae ƒu. Emegbe la, Saul gada Dawid ƒu ake kple eƒe akplɔ la. Eyata Dawid nya azɔ be ele be yeakpɔ nyuie.

Èɖo ŋku ŋugbe, si Saul do la dzia? Egblɔ be yeatsɔ ye vinyɔnuvi na amesi awu Goliat la wòaɖe. Mlɔeba la, Saul gblɔ na Dawid be ate ŋu aɖe ye vi Mixal, gake gbã la, ele be wòawu futɔ Filistitɔ 100 hafi. Bu ema ŋu kpɔ! Saul nɔ mɔ kpɔm be Filistitɔwo awu Dawid. Gake womewui o, eyata Saul tsɔ vianyɔnuvi la na Dawid wòɖe.

Gbeɖeka la, Saul gblɔ na Yonatan kple esubɔlawo katã be yedi be yeawu Dawid. Gake Yonatan gblɔ na fofoa be: ‘Mègawɔ nuvevi Dawid o. Mewɔ nu gbegblẽ aɖeke ɖe ŋuwò o. Ke boŋ nusianu, si wòwɔ la nye kpekpeɖeŋu gã aɖe na wò. Etsɔ eƒe agbe de afɔku me hewu Goliat, eye esi nèkpɔe la, edzɔ dzi na wò.’

Saul se via ƒe gbe, eye wòdo ŋugbe be yemawɔ nuvevi Dawid o. Wokplɔ Dawid gbɔe, eye wògasubɔ le Saul ƒe aƒeme abe tsã ene. Gake gbeɖeka esi Dawid nɔ ha ƒom la, Saul gada eƒe akplɔ la Dawid. Dawid de axae, eye akplɔ la tɔ gli la. Zi etɔ̃liae nye esia! Fifia Dawid nya be ele be yeasi!

Le zã me la, Dawid dzo yi eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒeme. Gake Saul dɔ ame aɖewo be woawui. Mixal nya nusi fofoa ɖo be yeawɔ la. Eyata egblɔ na srɔ̃a be: ‘Ne mèsi le zã sia me o la, woawu wò etsɔ.’ Zã ma me la, Mixal kpe ɖe Dawid ŋuti wòsi to fesre nu. Ehiã be Dawid nanɔ bebem tso teƒe yi teƒe abe ƒe adre ene be Saul magakpɔe o.Samuel I, 18:1-30; 19:1-18. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

ÈNYA nyɔnu dzetugbe, si gbɔna Dawid gbɔ la? Eŋkɔe nye Abigail. Susu nyui le esi, eyata exe mɔ na Dawid be magawɔ nu gbegblẽ o. Gake hafi míasrɔ̃ nu tso ema ŋu la, na míakpɔ nusi nɔ dzɔdzɔm ɖe Dawid dzi la ɖa.

Esi Dawid si le Saul nu la, ebe ɖe agado aɖe me. Nɔviawo kple eƒe ƒometɔ mamlɛawo ɖakpe ɖe eŋu le afima. Ame abe 400 ene va egbɔ, eye Dawid va zu woƒe kplɔla. Emegbe Dawid yi Moab-fia gbɔ hegblɔ nɛ be: ‘Taflatse na fofonye kple danye nanɔ gbɔwò vaseɖe esime makpɔ nusi adzɔ ɖe dzinye.’ Emegbe la, Dawid kple eƒe amewo te bebe ɖe towo dzi.

Esia megbee Dawid va kpɔ Abigail. Srɔ̃a Nabal nye anyigbatɔ aɖe, si nye kesinɔtɔ. Alẽ 3,000 kple gbɔ̃ 1,000 le esi. Nabal nye ame vloe aɖe. Gake srɔ̃a Abigail dze tugbe ŋutɔ. Enya nu dzɔdzɔe hã wɔwɔ. Gbeɖeka la, eɖe eƒe ƒomea tso afɔku me gɔ̃ hã. Na míakpɔ alesi wòwɔe la ɖa.

Dawid kple eƒe amewo nyo dɔme na Nabal. Wokpe ɖe wo ŋu hekpɔ eƒe alẽwo ta. Eyata gbeɖeka Dawid dɔ eƒe ame aɖewo ɖe Nabal be wòana nu ye. Dawid ƒe amewo va Nabal gbɔ esime wo kple eƒe kpeɖeŋutɔwo le fu kom na alẽwo. Nuɖukplɔ̃ɖogbee wònye, eyata nu geɖe le Nabal si wòaɖu. Eyata Dawid ƒe ameawo gblɔ be: ‘Míenyo dɔme na mi. Míefi miaƒe alẽ aɖeke o, ke boŋ míekpɔ wo dzi nyuie. Eyata azɔ taflatse mina nuɖuɖu aɖe mí.’

Nabal gblɔ be: ‘Nyematsɔ nye nuɖuɖu na mi amesiawo ƒomevi o.’ Eƒo nu movitɔe, eye wògblɔ nya vɔ̃wo ɖe Dawid ŋu. Esi ameawo yi ɖagblɔ nya la na Dawid la, Dawid do dziku ŋutɔ. Egblɔ na eƒe ameawo be: ‘Mitsɔ miaƒe yiwo!’ Tete wodze mɔ heyi Nabal kple eƒe amewo wu ge.

Nabal ƒe amewo dometɔ ɖeka, si se Nabal ƒe movinyawo la gblɔ nusi dzɔ la na Abigail. Enumake Abigail ƒo nuɖuɖu aɖewo nu ƒu. Etsɔe do agbae ɖe tedziwo dzi hedze mɔ. Esi wòdo go Dawid la, eɖi le eƒe tedzia dzi hebɔbɔ gblɔ be: ‘Taflatse mègaɖo to srɔ̃nye Nabal ƒe nyawo o. Movitɔe wònye, eye movinue wòwɔna. Nunanae nye si. Taflatse xɔe, eye nàtsɔ nusi dzɔ la ake mí.’

Dawid gblɔ be: ‘Nyɔnu nunyalae nènye. Ètsi nunye be nyemewu Nabal atsɔ ɖo eƒe movinuwɔwɔ teƒe nɛ o. Azɔ yi aƒeme le ŋutifafa me.’ Emegbe esi Nabal ku la, Abigail va zu Dawid srɔ̃wo dometɔ ɖeka.Samuel I, 22:1-4; 25:1-43. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

SAUL gadze agbagba be yeƒe asi nasu Dawid dzi. Eɖe eƒe aʋawɔla nyuitɔwo dometɔ 3,000 heyi edi ge. Esi Dawid se esia la, edɔ ŋkutsalawo be woaɖadi afisi Saul kple eƒe amewo ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖo le zã me la. Emegbe Dawid bia eƒe amewo dometɔ eve be: ‘Mia dometɔ kae ayi Saul ƒe asaɖa me kplim?’

Abisai ɖo ŋu be: ‘Mayi.’ Abisai nye Dawid nɔvinyɔnu Zeruya ƒe viŋutsu. Esi Saul kple eƒe amewo le alɔ̃ dɔm la, Dawid kple eƒe amewo ta minyaminya yi ɖe asaɖa la me. Wokɔ Saul ƒe akplɔ kple eƒe tsigoe, si le eƒe ta gbɔ tututu la. Esi wònye wo katã dɔ alɔ̃ tsiɖitsiɖi ta la, ame aɖeke mekpɔ wo alo se wo ŋkɔ o.

Kpɔ Dawid kple Abisai ɖa. Wosi dzo ɖatsi tre ɖe to aɖe tame dedie. Dawid do ɣli ɖo ɖe Israel-ʋakplɔlagã be: ‘Abner, nukatae mèle wò aƒetɔ, fia, la ŋu dzɔm o? Kpɔ ɖa! Afikae eƒe akplɔ kple eƒe tsigoe la le?’

Saul nyɔ. Edze si Dawid ƒe gbe, eye wòbia be: ‘Dawid, wòe nye ma?’ Èkpɔ Saul kple Abner le afima ɖa?

Dawid ɖo ŋu na Saul be: ‘Ẽ, nye aƒetɔ,’ eye wògabia be: ‘Nukatae nèle didim be yealém? Nuvɔ̃ kae mewɔ? Wò akplɔ lae nye si, O fia. Dɔ wò ame ɖeka ɖa wòava xɔe.’ Saul ʋu eme be: ‘Mewɔ nuvɔ̃. Mewɔ bometsinu.’ Tete Dawid trɔ dzo, eye Saul trɔ yi aƒeme. Gake Dawid gblɔ na eɖokui be: ‘Saul le wuye ge le ŋkeke siawo me. Ele be masi ayi Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi.’ Eye wòwɔ nenema. Dawid te ŋu flu Filistitɔwo woxɔ se be azɔ ele yewoƒe akpa dzi.

Ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe la, Filistitɔwo yi aʋa wɔ ge kple Israel. Wowu Saul kple Yonatan le aʋa la me. Esia wɔ nublanui na Dawid ŋutɔ, eye wòŋlɔ ha vivi aɖe, si wòdzi be: ‘Wò nu vem ŋutɔ, nɔvinye Yonatan. Wò nu dze ŋunye ŋutɔ!’

Esia megbe la, Dawid trɔ yi Israel le Hebron-du me. Le afima la, aʋa dzɔ ɖe amesiwo tia Saul ƒe vi Is-Boset be wòanye fia la, kple ame bubu, siwo di be Dawid nanye fia la dome. Gake mlɔeba la, Dawid ƒe amewo ɖu dzi. Dawid xɔ ƒe 30 esime woɖoe fiae. Eɖu fia ƒe adre kple afã le Hebron. Ŋutsuvi, siwo wodzi nɛ le afima la dometɔ aɖewo ŋkɔe nye Amnon, Absalom kple Adoniya.

Ɣeyiɣi aɖe ɖo esime Dawid kple eƒe amewo yi be yewoaxɔ du nyui aɖe, si nye Yerusalem la. Yoab, si nye Dawid nɔvinyɔnu Zeruya ƒe viŋutsu bubu lae nɔ ŋgɔ le aʋa la me. Eyata Dawid ɖo eteƒe na Yoab be wòtsɔe ɖo amegãe ɖe eƒe aʋawɔlawo nu. Azɔ Dawid dze fiaɖuɖu gɔme le Yerusalem.Samuel I, 26:1-25; 27:1-7; 31:1-6; Samuel II, 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; Kronika I, 11:1-9. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

ESI Dawid dze fiaɖuɖu gɔme le Yerusalem megbe la, Yehowa na eƒe aʋawɔlawo ɖu futɔ geɖe dzi. Yehowa do ŋugbe be yeatsɔ Kanaan-nyigba la na Israel-viwo. Le Yehowa ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu me la, anyigba, si ƒe ŋugbe wodo na wo la katã va zu wo tɔ azɔ.

Dawid nye dziɖula nyui aɖe. Elɔ̃ Yehowa. Eyata nu gbãtɔ, si wòwɔ le Yerusalem xɔxɔ megbe enye be, etsɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la va afimae. Edi hã be yeatu gbedoxɔ adae ɖe eme.

Esi Dawid tsi la, ewɔ vodada vɔ̃ɖi aɖe. Dawid nya be enye nu gbegblẽ be woaxɔ ame bubu ƒe nu. Gake gbeɖeka ɣetrɔ esime wònɔ eƒe fiasa tame la, ekpɔ nyɔnu aɖe, si dze tugbe ŋutɔ. Eŋkɔe nye Bat-Seba, eye srɔ̃a nye eƒe aʋawɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka, si ŋkɔe nye Uriya.

Dawid lɔ̃ Bat-Seba ale gbegbe be ena wokplɔe va eƒe fiasa mee. Srɔ̃a yi aʋa wɔ ge. Dawid dɔ kplii, eye emegbe la, nyɔnua kpɔ be yefɔ fu. Dawid ƒe susu tɔtɔ ale gbegbe, eye wòdɔ ame ɖo ɖe eƒe aʋakplɔlagã Yoab be woaɖo Uriya aʋa la ŋgɔ afisi woawui le. Esi Uriya ku la, Dawid ɖe Bat-Seba.

Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe Dawid ŋu ŋutɔ. Eyata edɔ eƒe dɔla Natan be wòagblɔ nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la nɛ. Kpɔ, Natan ye ma le nu ƒom na Dawid le afima. Eve Dawid ŋutɔ be yewɔ nenema, eyata Yehowa mewui o. Gake Yehowa gblɔ be: ‘Esi nèwɔ nuvɔ̃ siawo ta la, dzɔgbevɔ̃e geɖe anɔ aƒewò me.’ Eye Dawid kpɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e geɖe vavã!

Gbã la, Bat-Seba ƒe viŋutsuvi la ku. Emegbe Dawid ƒe viŋutsuvi gbãtɔ Amnon lé nɔvianyɔnu Tamar hedɔ egbɔ sesẽe. Esia ve dɔme na Dawid ƒe vi Absalom ale gbegbe be wòwu Amnon. Emegbe la, Absalom ƒe nu dze ame geɖe ŋu, eyata wòɖo fia eɖokui. Mlɔeba la, Dawid ɖu Absalom dzi le aʋa me, eye wòku. Ẽ, Dawid kpɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e geɖe vavã.

Le esiawo katã me la, Bat-Seba dzi ŋutsuvi, si ŋkɔe nye Salomo. Esi Dawid tsi hele dɔ lém la, viaŋutsuvi Adoniya di be yeaɖo fia ye ɖokui. Tete Dawid na nunɔla aɖe, si nye Zadok la kɔ ami ɖe tame na Salomo be wòatsɔ afia be Salomo anye fia. Eteƒe medidi o la, Dawid ku esime wòxɔ ƒe 70. Eɖu dzi hena ƒe 40; ke azɔ la, Salomo ye nye fia ɖe Israel.Samuel II, 11:1-27; 12:1-18; Fiawo I, 1:1-48. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

SALOMO nye ƒewuivi esime wòzu fia. Elɔ̃ Yehowa, eye wòdzea aɖaŋu nyui, si fofoa Dawid ɖo nɛ la yome. Yehowa kpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe Salomo ŋu, eyata egblɔ nɛ le drɔ̃e me le zã aɖe me be: ‘Salomo, nukae nèdi be mana ye?’

Tete Salomo ɖo ŋu be: ‘Yehowa, nye Mawu, ɖevi ko menye, eye nyemenya alesi maɖu fiae o. Eyata nam nunya be matsɔ aɖu wò amewo dzie le mɔ dzɔdzɔe nu.’

Nusi Salomo bia la dze Yehowa ŋu. Eyata egblɔ be: ‘Esi wònye mèbia agbe didi kple kesinɔnuwo o, ke boŋ nunya ta la, mana nunya wò wu amesiame, si nɔ anyi kpɔ. Gake mana nusi mèbia o la wò, kesinɔnuwo kple ŋutikɔkɔe siaa.’

Eteƒe medidi o la, nyɔnu eve tsɔ nya sesẽ aɖe va Salomo gbɔe. Wo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ be: ‘Mí kple nyɔnu sia míele xɔ ɖeka me. Medzi ŋutsuvi, eye ŋkeke eve megbe la, eya hã dzi ŋutsuvi. Gbeɖeka le zã me la, eƒe vidzĩe la ku. Ke esi mele alɔ̃ me la, ekɔ via kuku la mlɔ axanye hekɔ vinyea. Esi mefɔ hekpɔ ɖevi kukua la, mekpɔ be menye tɔnyee o.’

Tete nyɔnu kemɛa gblɔ be: ‘Gbeɖe o! Tɔnyee nye ɖevi gbagbe la, eye etɔe nye kukua!’ Nyɔnu gbãtɔ ɖo ŋu be: ‘Ao! tɔwòe nye ɖevi kukua, eye tɔnyee nye agbagbea!’ Nyɔnuawo nɔ nyaʋiʋlia dzi alea. Nuka wɔ ge Salomo ala?

Edɔ be woatsɔ yi vɛ; esi wotsɔe vɛ la, egblɔ be: ‘Mife ɖevi gbagbe la me ɖe eve, eye mitsɔ afã na wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe.’ Dadaa ŋutɔŋutɔ do ɣli be: ‘Gbeɖe o! Taflatse migawu ɖevi la o. Mitsɔe nɛ!’ Gake nyɔnu kemɛa gblɔ be: ‘Migatsɔe na mía dometɔ aɖeke o; mife eme ɖe eve.’

Salomo gblɔ mlɔeba be: ‘Migawu ɖevi la o! Mitsɔe na nyɔnu gbãtɔ. Eyae nye dadaa ŋutɔŋutɔ.’ Salomo nya esia, elabena vidada ŋutɔŋutɔ lɔ̃ ɖevi la ale gbegbe be elɔ̃ be woatsɔe na nyɔnu kemɛa be womagawui o. Esi amewo se alesi Salomo kpɔ nya la gbɔe la, edzɔ dzi na wo ŋutɔ be fia nyanu ma le yewo si.

Le Salomo ƒe dziɖuɣi la, Mawu yra ameawo be wòna anyigba la wɔ ƒo kple lu, weintsetsewo kple gbotsetsewo kple nuɖuɖu bubu geɖe. Ameawo ta avɔ nyuiwo henɔ aƒe nyuiwo me. Amesiame kpɔ nu nyui ɖesiaɖe wògbɔ eme.Fiawo I, 3:3-28; 4:29-34. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

HAFI Dawid naku la, etsɔ Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la ƒe dzidzeme, si tso Mawu gbɔ la na Salomo. Le eƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe ƒe enelia me la, Salomo dze gbedoxɔ la tutu gɔme, eye wòtsɔ ƒe adre kple afã tui. Ame akpe nanewo wɔ dɔ le gbedoxɔ la ŋu, eye wogblẽ ga geɖe ɖe xɔa tutu ŋu. Elabena wozã sika kple klosalo geɖe.

Xɔ gã eve le gbedoxɔ la ŋu abe alesi wònɔ le avɔgbadɔ la me ene. Gake xɔ siawo lolo wu avɔgbadɔa tɔ teƒe eve. Salomo na woda nubablaɖaka la ɖe gbedoxɔa ƒe emetɔa me, eye nu bubu, siwo le gbedoxɔa me la le xɔ evelia me.

Esi wowu gbedoxɔa nu la, woɖu ŋkekenyui gã aɖe. Salomo dze klo ɖe gbedoxɔ la ŋkume hedo gbe ɖa abe alesi nàkpɔe le nɔnɔmetata la me ene. Salomo gblɔ na Yehowa be: ‘Dziƒoa katã gɔ̃ hã melolo na wò o, kaka wòahanye gbedoxɔ sia, si metu na wò. Gake, Oo nye Mawu, taflatse se wò dukɔ la ƒe gbedodoɖa ɖe teƒe sia ŋu.’

Esi Salomo do gbe ɖa vɔ la, dzo tso dziƒo va. Efiã lã ƒe vɔsa, si woɖo anyi la. Eye keklẽ aɖe tso Yehowa gbɔ yɔ gbedoxɔ la taŋ. Esia fia be Yehowa le to ɖom, eye ekpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe gbedoxɔ la kple Salomo ƒe gbedodoɖa la ŋu. Fifia gbedoxɔ la zu afisi ameawo va dea ta agu le, ke menye avɔgbadɔ me o. Salomo ɖu fia le nunya me hena ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe, eye ameawo kpɔ dzidzɔ. Gake Salomo ɖe nyɔnu geɖe tso dukɔ bubuwo me, amesiwo mesubɔa Yehowa o. Èkpɔ wo dometɔ ɖeka wòle legba subɔma? Mlɔeba la, Salomo srɔ̃wo na eya hã subɔ mawu bubuwo. Ne Salomo wɔ nusia la, ènya nusi dzɔna? Megagbɔa dzi ɖi na ameawo o. Enɔa ŋuta sẽm, eye ameawo megakpɔa dzidzɔ azɔ o.

Esia na Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe Salomo ŋu, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: ‘Maxɔ fiaɖuƒe la le asiwò atsɔ na ame bubu. Nyemawɔ esia le wò agbenɔɣi o, ke boŋ le viwò ƒe fiaɖuɣi. Gake nyemaxɔ fiaɖuƒea teviwo katã le viwò si o.’ Na míakpɔ alesi esia dzɔe la ɖa.Kronika I, 28:9-21; 29:1-9; Fiawo I, 5:15-32; Kronika II, 6:12-42; 7:1-5; Fiawo I, 11:9-13. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

ÈNYA nusita ŋutsu sia le eƒe awu vuvum kakɛkakɛa? Yehowae be nevuvui. Ŋutsu siae nye Mawu ƒe nyagblɔɖila Axiya. Ènya amesi nye nyagblɔɖila? Enye amesi Mawu gblɔa nusi gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la na doa ŋgɔ.

Axiya le nu ƒom na Yerobeam le afisia. Yerobeam nye ŋutsu, si Salomo ɖo eƒe xɔtudɔ la ƒe akpa aɖe nu. Esi Axiya do go Yerobeam le mɔ sia dzi la, Axiya wɔ nukunu aɖe. Eɖe awu ʋlaya yeye, si wòdo la hevuvui ɖe kakɛ 12 me. Egblɔ na Yerobeam be: ‘Lɔ kakɛ 10 na ɖokuiwò.’ Ènya nusita Axiya tsɔ kakɛ 10 na Yerobeam mahã?

Axiya ɖe eme be, Yehowa le fiaɖuƒe la xɔ ge le Salomo si. Egblɔ be Yehowa le to 10 tsɔ ge na Yerobeam. Esia fia be to eve koe asusɔ na Salomo ƒe vi Rexabeam wòaɖu fia ɖe edzi.

Esi Salomo se nusi Axiya gblɔ na Yerobeam la, dzi kui ŋutɔ. Edi be yeawu Yerobeam. Gake Yerobeam si yi Egipte. Ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe la, Salomo ku. Eɖu fia hena ƒe 40; ke azɔ la, via Rexabeam zu fia. Yerobeam se le Egipte be Salomo ku, eyata egbɔ va Israel.

Rexabeam menye fia ɖɔʋu o. Esẽ ŋuta ameawo ŋu wu fofoa Salomo gɔ̃ hã. Yerobeam kple ame ŋkuta aɖewo yi Fia Rexabeam gbɔ hebiae be wòakpɔ nublanui na ameawo. Gake Rexabeam gbe. Le nyateƒe me la, esẽ ŋuta wu tsã. Eyata ameawo ɖo fia Yerobeam ɖe to 10 dzi; gake Benyamin kple Yuda ƒe to eveawo lɔ̃ be Rexabeam nanye yewoƒe fia.

Yerobeam melɔ̃ be yeƒe amewo nayi Yerusalem aɖasubɔ le Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ me o. Eyata ewɔ sikanyivi eve, eye wòna to 10 fiaɖuƒe la subɔ wo. Eteƒe medidi o la, anyigba la yɔ fũ kple hlɔ̃dodo kple nuvlowɔwɔ.

Dzɔgbevɔ̃e hã ɖo to eve fiaɖuƒe la me. Esi Rexabeam zu fia mede ƒe atɔ̃ haɖe o la, Egipte-fia va wɔ aʋa kple Yerusalem. Etsɔ kesinɔnu geɖe dzoe le Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ me. Eyata ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe koe gbedoxɔ la nɔ kɔkɔe abe alesi wotui la ene.Fiawo I, 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

LE FIA Yerobeam ƒe ku megbe la, fia ɖesiaɖe, si ɖu Israel ƒe to 10 fiaɖuƒea dzi la vɔ̃ɖi. Fia Axab ye vɔ̃ɖi wu wo katã. Ènya nusitaea? Susu vevi ɖeka, si ta lae nye srɔ̃a, Fianyɔnu vɔ̃ɖi Izebel.

Izebel menye Israel-nyɔnu o. Enye Zidon-fia vinyɔnu. Esubɔa alakpamawu Baal, eye wònana Axab kple Israeltɔ geɖe hã subɔa Baal. Izebel lé fu Yehowa, eye wòwua eƒe nyagblɔɖila geɖe. Ame aɖewo be ɖe agadowo me be womagawu wo o. Ne Izebel le nane dim la, ewua ame kura gɔ̃ hã be eƒe asi nasu edzi.

Gbeɖeka la, Fia Axab lé blanui vevie. Eye Izebel biae be: ‘Nukatae nèlé blanui egbea?’

Axab ɖo ŋu be: ‘Nusi Nabot gblɔ nam egbea la tae. Medi be maƒle eƒe weingble la. Gake ebe yemadzrae nam o.’

Izebel gblɔ be: ‘Mègaxa nu o. Maxɔe na wò.’

Eye Izebel ŋlɔ agbalẽ ɖo ɖe afisi Nabot le la ƒe dumegãwo. Egblɔ na wo be: ‘Midi yakame aɖewo ne woagblɔ be Nabot do ɖiŋu na Mawu kple fia la, eye miakplɔ Nabot ado goe ɖe dua godo aƒu kpee wòaku.’

Esi Izebel se be Nabot ku teti ko la, egblɔ na Axab be: ‘Azɔ heyi nàxɔ eƒe weingble la.’ Ðe mèxɔe se be ele be woahe to na Izebel le ŋɔdzinu, si wòwɔ la ta oa?

Eyata emegbe la, Yehowa dɔ Yehu be wòahe to nɛ. Esi Izebel se be Yehu gbɔna la, esi nu ɖe eƒe ŋkuwo, eye wòdze agbagba ɖo atsyɔ̃ na eɖokui be yeanya kpɔ. Gake esi Yehu va, eye wòkpɔ Izebel le fesre nu la, egblɔ na amesiwo le fiasa la me be: ‘Mitutui ƒu anyi!’ Ameawo tu asii ƒu anyi abe alesi nàte ŋu akpɔe le nɔnɔmetataa me ene. Wotu asii ƒu anyigba wòku. Fianyɔnu vɔ̃ɖi Izebel ƒe nuwuƒee nye esia.Fiawo I, 16:29-33; 18:1-4; 21:1-16; Fiawo II, 9:30-37. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

data.titulo: Yehosafat Ðo Dzi Ðe Yehowa Ŋu
data.contenido:
ÈNYA ŋutsu siawo kple nusi wɔm wolea? Woyina aʋa, eye ŋutsu, siwo le ŋgɔ la le ha dzim. Gake ɖewohĩ àbia be: ‘Nukatae yiwo kple akplɔwo mele hadzilawo si be woawɔ aʋae o?’ Na míakpɔe ɖa.

Yosafat nye Israel ƒe to eve fiaɖuƒe la ƒe fia. Enɔ anyi le ɣeyiɣi, si tututu me to 10 ƒe dziehe fiaɖuƒe ƒe Fia Axab kple Izebel nɔ anyi la me. Gake Yosafat nye fia nyui aɖe, eye fofoa Asa hã nye fia nyui aɖe. Eyata amesiwo le to eve ƒe anyiehe fiaɖuƒea me la nɔ agbe vivi.

Gake fifia nane dzɔ, si do vɔvɔ̃ na ameawo. Dɔlawo va gblɔ na Yosafat be: ‘Aʋakɔ gã aɖe tso Moab, Amon kple Seir-to ƒe dukɔwo me be woava dze dziwò.’ Israel-vi geɖe ƒo ƒu ɖe Yerusalem be woabia Yehowa ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Woyi gbedoxɔ la me, eye Yosafat do gbe ɖa le afima be: ‘O Yehowa mía Mawu, míenya nusi míawɔ o. Wɔna aɖeke mele mía ŋu le aʋakɔ gã sia nu o. Wòe míekpɔ mɔ na hena kpekpeɖeŋu.’

Yehowa see, eye wòna esubɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ na ameawo be: ‘Aʋa la menye mia tɔ o, ke Mawu tɔe. Menye miawoe le aʋa la wɔ ge o. Minɔ nu kpɔm ko, eye miakpɔ alesi Yehowa le mia ɖe gee ɖa.’

Esi ŋu ke la, Yosafat gblɔ na ameawo be: ‘Miɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu!’ Eye wòɖo hadzilawo eƒe aʋawɔlawo ŋgɔ, eye esi wonɔ azɔlia dzi la, wonɔ kafukafuhawo dzim na Yehowa. Esi wotu aʋa la kpuie la, ènya nusi dzɔa? Yehowa na be asrafo, siwo nye futɔwo la wɔ aʋa kple wo nɔewo. Eye hafi Israel-viwo naɖo la, asrafo, siwo nye futɔwo la dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ku!

Ðe menye nunyanu be Yosafat ɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu oa? Ne míawo hã míeɖo dzi ɖe eŋu la, míanye nunyalawo.Fiawo I, 22:41-53; Kronika II, 20:1-30. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

NE ÈKU, eye wogagbɔ agbe wò ɖe, aleke dawò awɔ? Akpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ! Gake ɖe amesi ku la agate ŋu agbɔ agbea? Ðe wòdzɔ kpɔa?

Kpɔ ŋutsu ma, nyɔnu ma, kple ŋutsuvi ma ɖa. Ŋutsu lae nye nyagblɔɖila Eliya. Nyɔnu la, nye ahosi aɖe, si tso Zarpat, eye viae nye ŋutsuvi la. Gbeɖeka la, ŋutsuvi la dze dɔ. Dɔa sesẽ ale gbegbe be wòku. Eye Eliya gblɔ na nyɔnu la be: ‘Tsɔ ɖevi la nam.’

Eliya kɔ ɖevi la yi xɔtaxɔ mee hetsɔe mlɔ aba dzi. Edo gbe ɖa be: ‘O Yehowa, na ɖevi sia nagagbɔ agbe.’ Tete ɖevi la de asi gbɔgbɔ me! Eye Eliya kɔe tso xɔtaxɔa me ɖi va anyi hegblɔ na dadaa be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, viwò la gbɔ agbe!’ Esia tae dadaa kpɔ dzidzɔ alea gbegbe ɖo.

Yehowa ƒe nyagblɔɖila vevi bubu aɖe ŋkɔe nye Elisa. Esubɔna abe Eliya ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ ene. Gake emegbe la, Yehowa na Elisa hã wɔ nukunuwo. Gbeɖeka la, Elisa yi Sunem, afisi nyɔnu aɖe nyo dɔme nɛ le. Emegbe la, nyɔnu sia dzi ŋutsuvi.

Gbeɖeka ŋdi, esi ɖevia tsi la, eyi fofoa gbɔ le agble me. Tete ɖevia do ɣli be: ‘Nye ta le veyem!’ Wokɔ ɖevia yi aƒemee, eye emegbe wòku. Dadaa lé blanui ŋutɔ! Enumake wòyi ɖayɔ Elisa.

Esi Elisa va la, ekɔ ɖevi kuku la yi xɔ mee. Edo gbe ɖa na Yehowa hetsyɔ akɔ ɖe ɖevi la dzi. Tete ɖevi la xɔ dzo, eye wònyè zi adre. Dadaa kpɔ dzidzɔ ale gbegbe esi wòva kpɔ be ye vi la gbɔ agbe!

Ame geɖe woku. Esia na woƒe ƒometɔwo kple xɔlɔ̃wo lé blanui vevie. Ŋusẽ mele mía si be míafɔ ame kukuwo o. Gake ŋusẽ le Yehowa si. Emegbe la, míasrɔ̃ alesi wòafɔ ame akpeakpewo va agbe mee.Fiawo I, 17:8-24; Fiawo II, 4:8-37. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

data.titulo: Nyɔnuvi Aɖe Kpe Ðe Kalẽtɔ Aɖe Ŋu
data.contenido:
ÈNYA nya, si gblɔm nyɔnuvi sue sia lea? Ele Yehowa ƒe nyagblɔɖila Elisa, kple nukunu siwo Yehowa na wòwɔna la ŋutinya gblɔm na nyɔnu la. Esi nyɔnu la menye Israeltɔ o ta la, menya naneke tso Yehowa ŋu o. Ke azɔ na míakpɔ nusita nyɔnuvia le nyɔnua ƒe aƒeme la ɖa.

Nyɔnu la nye Siriatɔ. Srɔ̃a enye Naeman, Siria-ʋakɔ la ƒe amegã. Siriatɔwoe lé Israel-nyɔnuvi sue sia hekplɔ vɛ na Naeman srɔ̃ be wòanye eƒe subɔvi.

Dɔléle vɔ̃ɖi aɖe le Naeman ŋu, esi woyɔna be anyi. Dɔléle sia ate ŋu ana ame ƒe ŋutilã nanyi gɔ̃ hã. Eyata nyɔnuvi la le gbɔgblɔm na Naeman srɔ̃ be: ‘Medi be nye aƒetɔ nayi Yehowa ƒe nyagblɔɖila gbɔ le Israel. Ada eƒe anyi la nɛ.’ Emegbe la, wogblɔ nya sia na nyɔnu la srɔ̃.

Naeman di vevie be woada dɔa na ye, eyata eɖo be yeayi Israel. Esi wòɖo afima la, eyi Elisa ƒeme. Elisa dɔ eƒe dɔlawo be woagblɔ na Naeman be wòayi aɖale tsi le Yordan-tɔsisia me zi adre. Esia ku dzi na Naeman, eye wògblɔ be: ‘Tɔsisi, siwo le mía gbɔ la menyo wu esiwo le Israel oa?’ Esi Naeman gblɔ esia vɔ la etrɔ dzo.

Gake eƒe dɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ nɛ be: ‘Taflatse, ne Elisa ɖe wòɖo nu sesẽ aɖe na wò la, ne èwɔe. Ke nukatae màyi aɖale tsi ko abe alesi wògblɔ ene o?’ Naeman ɖo to eƒe dɔlawo, eye wòyi ɖanyrɔ eɖokui ɖe Yordan-tɔsisia me zi adre. Esi wòwɔe la, eƒe ŋutilã kɔ hezrɔ̃ nyuie!

Naeman kpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ. Etrɔ yi ɖagblɔ na Elisa be: ‘Azɔ menyae nyuie be Israel ƒe Mawu lae nye Mawu vavã ɖeka kolia, si le anyigba katã dzi. Eyata, taflatse, xɔ nunana sia.’ Gake Elisa ɖo ŋu be: ‘Ao, nyemaxɔe o.’ Elisa nya be menyo be yeaxɔ nunana la o, elabena Yehowae nye amesi da dɔ na Naeman. Gake Elisa ƒe subɔla Gexazi di be yeaxɔ nunana la na ye ɖokui.

Nusi Gexazi wɔ enye si. Esi Naeman dzo la, Gexazi ƒu du ɖaxe ŋutsu la hegblɔ nɛ be: ‘Elisa dɔm be magblɔ na wò be yeaxɔ wò nunana la ɖe na ye xɔlɔ̃, siwo va dze ye fifia la.’ Esia ya alakpae. Gake Naeman menya be alakpae o, eyata etsɔ nuawo ƒe ɖe na Gexazi.

Esi Gexazi trɔ yi aƒeme la, Elisa nya nusi wòwɔ la. Yehowa gblɔe nɛ. Eyata egblɔ be: ‘Esi nèwɔ nu baɖa sia ta la, Naeman ƒe anyi la ava dziwò.’ Enumake la, anyia ƒo ɖe eŋu!

Nukae míate ŋu asrɔ̃ tso esiawo katã me? Gbã la, ele be míanɔ abe nyɔnuvi sue la ene aƒo nu tso Yehowa ŋu. Ate ŋu aɖe vi geɖe. Evelia la, mele be míanɔ dadam abe alesi Naeman wɔ gbã ene o, ke boŋ ele be míaɖo to Mawu subɔlawo. Eye etɔ̃lia la, mele be míada alakpa abe Gexazi ene o. Míate ŋu asrɔ̃ nu geɖe tso Biblia la xexlẽ me oa?Fiawo II, 5:1-27. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

KPƆ ŋutsu, si le tɔa me la ɖa. Menye fukpekpe mee ma wòɖo oa? Tɔmelã ma le emi ge! Ènya amesi ŋutsu sia nyea? Eŋkɔe nye Yona. Na míakpɔ alesi wòwɔ hafi ɖo fukpekpe geɖe me la ɖa.

Yona nye Yehowa ƒe nyagblɔɖila. Esi nyagblɔɖila Elisa ku la, eteƒe medidi o Yehowa gblɔ na Yona be: ‘Yi Niniwe, du gã la me. Amesiwo le afima la ƒe vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ, eye medi be nàyi agblɔe na wo.’

Gake Yona medi be yeayi o. Eyata eɖo tɔdziʋu aɖe, si tso Niniwe yina du bubu me la. Yona ƒe sisi medzɔ dzi na Yehowa o. Eyata ena ahomya sesẽ aɖe ƒo. Eƒo sesĩe ale gbegbe be tɔdziʋua di be yeanyrɔ. Ʋua kulawo vɔ̃ ŋutɔ, eyata wodo ɣli yɔ woƒe mawuwo hena kpekpeɖeŋu. Yona gblɔ na wo mlɔeba be: ‘Yehowa, Mawu, si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba la subɔla menye. Eye mele sisim le dɔ, si Yehowa dɔm be mawɔ la nu.’ Eyata ʋua kulawo bia be: ‘Nukae míawɔ wò be ahomya la nadzudzɔ?’

Yona gblɔ na wo be: ‘Mikɔm ƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒua me, eye tsi la agadze akɔ anyi.’ Ʋua kulawo medi be yewoakɔe aƒu gbe o, gake esi ahomya la nyra ɖe edzi ta la, wokɔ Yona ƒu gbe mlɔeba. Enumake ahomya la dzudzɔ, eye atsiaƒu la gadze akɔ anyi ake.

Esi Yona nyrɔ ɖe tsia me la, tɔmelã gã la mii. Gake meku o. Enɔ tɔmelã la ƒe dɔme ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple zã etɔ̃. Eve Yona ŋutɔ be yemeɖo to Yehowa heyi Niniwe o. Eyata ènya nusi wòwɔa?

Yona do gbe ɖa be Yehowa nakpe ɖe ye ŋu. Eye Yehowa na tɔmelã la dzɔ Yona ɖe anyigba ƒuƒui dzi. Ema megbe la, Yona yi Niniwe. Ðe esia mefia mí be ele vevie be míawɔ nusianu, si Yehowa gblɔ la oa?Biblia ƒe agbalẽ, si nye Yona. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

ESIA nye paradiso, si ƒomevi Mawu tsɔ fia eƒe nyagblɔɖila Yesaya la ƒe nɔnɔmetata. Yesaya nɔ agbe le Yona ƒe agbenɔɣi megbe kpuie.

Paradiso gɔmee nye “abɔ” alo “gbadzaƒe.” Ðe wòɖo ŋku nane, si míekpɔ le agbalẽ sia me va yi la dzi na wòa? Mele abe abɔ nyui, si Yehowa Mawu wɔ na Adam kple Xawa la ene oa? Gake ɖe anyigba bliboa ava nye paradiso gbaɖegbea?

Yehowa gblɔ na eƒe nyagblɔɖila Yesaya be wòaŋlɔ nu tso paradiso yeye, si gbɔna na Mawu ƒe amewo la ŋuti. Egblɔ be: ‘Amegãxiwo kple alẽwo anɔ afi ɖeka le ŋutifafa me. Nyiviwo kple dzataviwo aɖu gbe le afi ɖeka, eye ŋutsuvi sue akplɔ wo. Ne vidzĩe fe le da gbɔ hã la, mawɔ nuvevii o.’

Ame geɖe agblɔ be: ‘Nusia mate ŋu ava eme gbeɖe o. Fukpekpe le anyigba dzi tso gbaɖegbe ke, eye woanɔ anyi ɖaa.’ Gake bu eŋu kpɔ: Aƒe ka ƒomevie Mawu tsɔ na Adam kple Xawa?

Mawu da Adam kple Xawa ɖe paradiso me. Esi womeɖo to Mawu o la ko tae wobu woƒe aƒe nyui la, ku amegã heku. Mawu do ŋugbe be yeana nusiwo Adam kple Xawa bu la amesiwo lɔ̃ ye la.

Le paradiso yeye, si gbɔna me la, naneke mawɔ nuvevi ame alo agblẽ nu o. Ŋutifafa deblibo anɔ anyi. Amesiame anɔ lãmesẽ kple dzidzɔ me. Anɔ pɛpɛpɛ abe alesi Mawu di be wòanɔ le gɔmedzedzea me ene. Gake emegbe la, míasrɔ̃ alesi Mawu ahe esia vɛ la.Yesaya 11:6-9; Nyaɖeɖefia 21:3, 4. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

data.titulo: Mawu Kpe Ðe Fia Hizkiya Ŋu
data.contenido:
ÈNYA nusitae ŋutsu sia le gbe dom ɖa na Yehowa? Nukatae wòkeke agbalẽ siawo ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ? Ŋutsu lae nye Xizkiya. Enye Israel ƒe anyiehe-to eve fiaɖuƒe la ƒe fia. Eye ele fukpekpe geɖe me. Nukatae?

Elabena Asiria-ʋakɔwo tsrɔ̃ dziehe ƒe to 10 la xoxo. Yehowa na wotsrɔ̃ wo, elabena ameawo vɔ̃ɖi ŋutɔ. Ke fifia la, Asiria-ʋakɔwo va aʋa wɔ ge kple to eve fiaɖuƒe la.

Fifi laa ko Asiria-fia ɖo agbalẽwo ɖe Fia Xizkiya. Agbalẽawoe nye esia Xizkiya ɖo Mawu ŋkume. Agbalẽawo ɖe alɔme le Yehowa ŋu, eye wobe Xizkiya nena ta. Esia tae Xizkiya do gbe ɖa be: ‘O, Yehowa, ɖe mí tso Asiria-fia si me. Eye dukɔwo katã nanya be wò ɖekae nye Mawu.’ Ðe Yehowa aɖo to Xizkiya?

Xizkiya nye fia nyui aɖe. Mele abe Israel-to 10 fiaɖuƒea ƒe fiawo alo fofoa, Fia Axaz vɔ̃ɖi la ene o. Xizkiya ɖo to Yehowa ƒe sewo katã nyuie. Eyata esi Xizkiya do gbe ɖa vɔ la, nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ɖo gbedasi sia ɖee tso Yehowa gbɔ be: ‘Asiria-fia mava Yerusalem o. Eƒe aʋawɔlawo dometɔ aɖeke mate ɖe eŋu o. Womada dati ɖeka hã ɖe du la me o.’ Kpɔ nɔnɔmetata, si le axa sia dzi la ɖa. Ènya amesiwo aʋawɔla kuku siawo katã nyea? Asiriatɔwoe. Yehowa dɔ eƒe dɔla, eye mawudɔla la wu Asiriatɔwo ƒe aʋawɔla 185,000 le zã ɖeka me. Eyata Asiria-fia la na ta hetrɔ dzo.

To eve fiaɖuƒe la kpɔ ɖeɖe, eye ameawo kpɔ ŋutifafa hena ɣeyiɣi aɖe. Esi Xizkiya ku la, viaŋutsuvi Manase zu fia. Manase kple via Amon, si kplɔe ɖo la nye fia vɔ̃ɖiwo. Eyata hlɔ̃dodo kple nuvlowɔwɔ gayɔ anyigba la dzi. Esi Amon ŋutɔ ƒe dɔla eve wowui la, woɖo viaŋutsuvi Yosiya fiae ɖe to eve fiaɖuƒe la dzi.Fiawo II, 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

ƑE ENYI ko Yosiya xɔ esime wòzu fia ɖe Israel ƒe anyieheto eve fiaɖuƒea dzi. Metsi kura hena fiaɖuɖu o. Eyata gbã la, ame tsitsi aɖewo kpe ɖe eŋu be wòaɖu dukɔ la dzi.

Esi Yosiya ɖu fia ƒe adre la, ede asi Yehowa didi me. Edze fia nyuiwo abe Dawid, Yosafat, kple Xizkiya ene ƒe kpɔɖeŋu yome. Emegbe esi wònye ƒewuivi ko la, Yosiya wɔ kalẽdɔ aɖe.

Israel-viwo dometɔ geɖe vɔ̃ɖi ŋutɔ hena ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe. Wosubɔ alakpamawuwo. Wode ta agu na legbawo. Eyata Yosiya kple eƒe amewo tso, eye wodze egɔme ɖe alakpamawuwo ɖa le anyigba la dzi. Dɔ gã aɖe enye esia, elabena alakpamawu subɔlawo sɔ gbɔ. Àte ŋu akpɔ Yosiya kple eƒe amewo le afisia wole legbawo gbãm.

Emegbe la, Yosiya ɖo ŋutsu etɔ̃ Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la dzadzraɖo nu. Wodzɔ ga le ameawo si hetsɔ na ŋutsu etɔ̃ siawo be woatsɔ axe fee na dɔwɔlawo. Esi wonɔ gbedoxɔa tum la, nunɔlagã Xilkiya kpɔ nu vevi aɖe le afima. Enye segbalẽ, si Yehowa na Mose ŋlɔ gbaɖegbe ʋĩ ke la. Ebu hena ƒe geɖe.

Wotsɔ agbalẽ la yi na Yosiya, eye wòbia be woaxlẽe na ye. Esi Yosiya nɔ to ɖom la, edze sii be ameawo mele Yehowa ƒe se dzi wɔm o. Esia vee ŋutɔ, eyata wòvuvu eƒe awuwo abe alesi nàte ŋu akpɔe le afisia ene. Egblɔ be: ‘Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe mía ŋu, elabena mía fofowo mewɔ se, si woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la dzi o.’ Yosiya bia nunɔlagã Xilkiya be wòadi nusi Yehowa le yewo wɔ ge la. Xilkiya yi nyɔnu nyagblɔɖila aɖe, si nye Xulda gbɔ hebia nya lae. Etsɔ Yehowa ƒe gbedasi sia nɛ be wòatsɔ ayi na Yosiya: ‘Woahe to na Yerusalem kple dukɔ la katã, elabena wosubɔ alakpamawuwo, eye nuvlowɔwɔ yɔ anyigba la dzi. Gake esi wò, Yosiya nèwɔ nusi nyo ta la, tohehe la mava o, negbe le wò ku megbe hafi.’Kronika II, 34:1-28. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

KPƆ, amesiawo le ɖekakpui sia kom. Ènya amesi wònyea? Yeremyae. Mawu ƒe nyagblɔɖila vevi aɖee wònye.

Esi Fia Yosiya dze legbawo gbagbã gɔme le anyigba dzi megbe teti ko la, Yehowa gblɔ na Yeremya be wòanye Yeƒe nyagblɔɖila. Gake Yeremya bu be yemetsi ne yeanye nyagblɔɖila o. Gake Yehowa gblɔ be yeakpe ɖe eŋu.

Yeremya gblɔ na Israel-viwo be woadzudzɔ nu vɔ̃ɖiwo wɔwɔ. Egblɔ be: ‘Mawu, si dukɔwo subɔna la, alakpamawuwo wonye.’ Gake Israel-vi geɖe subɔ legbawo hegblẽ Mawu vavã, Yehowa, ya ɖi. Esi Yeremya gblɔ na ameawo be Mawu ahe to na wo le woƒe vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi ta la, ɖeko wonɔ ekom.

Ƒewo va yi, Yosiya ku, eye ɣleti etɔ̃ megbe la, viaŋutsuvi Yoyakim zu fia. Yeremya nɔ egbɔgblɔ dzi na dukɔ la bena: ‘Ne mietrɔ miaƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo o la, woatsrɔ̃ Yerusalem.’ Nunɔlawo léa Yeremya hedoa ɣli be: ‘Ele be woawu wò le nya siawo gbɔgblɔ ta.’ Eye wogblɔna na Israel-amegãwo bena: ‘Ele be woawu Yeremya, elabena eƒo nu tsi tre ɖe míaƒe du la ŋu.’

Nuka wɔ ge Yeremya ala fifia? Mele vɔvɔ̃m o! Egblɔ na wo katã be: ‘Yehowae dɔm be magblɔ nya siawo na mi. Ne mietrɔ miaƒe agbenɔnɔ vɔ̃wo o la, Yehowa atsrɔ̃ Yerusalem. Gake minya esia bena: ‘Ne miewum la, ke miewu amesi mewɔ nuvɔ̃ aɖeke o.’

Amegãwo mewu Yeremya o, gake Israel-viwo metrɔ le woƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo yome o. Emegbe la, Babilon-fia, Nebukadnezar va wɔ aʋa kple Yerusalem. Mlɔeba la, Nebukadnezar tsɔ Israel-viwo wɔ eƒe dɔlawoe. Ekplɔ ame akpe geɖe yi Babilon. Bu eŋu kpɔ be alekee ma wòanɔ; be amedzro aɖe nava kplɔ wò tso wò aƒeme ayi dzronyigba aɖe dzie!Yeremya 1:1-8; 10:1-5; 26:1-16; Fiawo II, 24:1-17. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

FIA Nebukadnezar kplɔ Israel-vi agbalẽnyala nyuitɔwo katã yi ɖe Babilon. Emegbe la, fia la tia ɖekakpui dzeɖekɛ, siwo zã wu ɖesiaɖe la le wo dome. Wo dometɔ enee nye ɖekakpui, siwo kpɔm nèle le afisia. Ðekae nye Daniel, eye Babiloniatɔwo yɔa etɔ̃ mamlɛawo be Sadrax, Mesax kple Abed-Nego.

Nebukadnezar ɖo be yeahe ɖekakpuiawo be woasubɔ le yeƒe fiasa me. Ne ehe wo hena ƒe etɔ̃ vɔ la, atia zazɛ̃tɔwo kekeake ɖeɖe be woakpe ɖe ye ŋu le nya sesẽwo me. Fia la di be ɖekakpuiawo ƒe lãme nasẽ nyuie le woƒe hehe la me. Eyata ede se be yeƒe subɔlawo natsɔ nuɖuɖu dami kple wein, si wotsɔna vɛ na ye kple yeƒe ƒomea la ke na ɖekakpuiawo katã.

Kpɔ ɖekakpui Daniel ɖa. Ènya nya, si gblɔm wòle na Nebukadnezar subɔlawo ƒe amegã Aspenaz mahã? Daniel le gbɔgblɔm nɛ be yemedi be yeaɖu fia ƒe nu damiawo o. Gake nya la ɖe fu na Aspenaz. Egblɔ be: ‘Fia lae tia nusi wòle be miaɖu ahano la. Eyata ne miaƒe lãme mesẽ abe ɖekakpui bubuawo tɔ ene o la, awum.’

Eye Daniel yi dzikpɔla, si Aspenaz ɖo eya kple exɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo nu la gbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: ‘Taflatse do mí kpɔ hena ŋkeke 10. Na amagbewo mí míaɖu, kple tsi, si míano. Emegbe nàtsɔ mí asɔ kple ɖekakpui bubu, siwo le fia ƒe nu ɖum la be amekawoe anya kpɔ wu hã.’

Dzikpɔla la lɔ̃ ɖe edzi. Ke esi ŋkeke 10 la de la, Daniel kple exɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo ƒe lãme nya kpɔ wu ɖekakpui mamlɛawo katã. Eyata dzikpɔla la na woyi amagbeawo ɖuɖu dzi ɖe nusi fia na wo la teƒe.

Ƒe etɔ̃a megbe la, wokplɔ ɖekakpuiawo katã yi Nebukadnezar gbɔe. Esi fia la ƒo nu na wo katã vɔ la, ekpɔ be Daniel kple exɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃wo zã wu amesiame. Eyata exɔ wo be woakpe ɖe ye ŋu le fiasa la me. Eye ne fia la bia nya alo de nya sesẽwo asi na Daniel, Sadrax, Mesax kple Abed-Nego la, wosea egɔme zi 10 wu eƒe nunɔla kple nunyala ɖesiaɖe.Daniel 1:1-21. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

EWU ƒe 10 tso esime Fia Nebukadnezar kplɔ Israel ƒe agbalẽnyala nyuiwo katã yi Babilon. Ke azɔ kpɔ nusi le dzɔdzɔm la ɖa! Wotɔ dzo Yerusalem. Eye wokplɔ Israel-vi, siwo womewu o la yina ɖe Babilon abe gamenɔlawo ene.

Ðo ŋku edzi be esiae Yehowa ƒe nyagblɔɖila la gblɔ be adzɔ ne ameawo metrɔ le woƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo dzi o. Gake Israel-viawo meɖo to nyagblɔɖilawo o. Wogblẽ Yehowa ɖi hesubɔ alakpamawuwo. Eyata ameawo dze na tohehe. Míenya esia, elabena Mawu ƒe nyagblɔɖila Xezekiel gblɔ nuvɔ̃, siwo Israel-viwo nɔ wɔwɔm la na mí.

Ènya amesi Xezekiel nyea? Enye ɖekakpui, siwo Fia Nebukadnezar kplɔ yi Babilon ƒe 10 megbe hafi wotsrɔ̃ Yerusalem la dometɔ ɖeka. Ɣeyiɣi ma ke mee wokplɔ Daniel kple exɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo, Sadrax, Mesax kple Abed-Nego hã yi Babilon.

Esi Xezekiel gale Babilon la, Yehowa ɖe nu gbegblẽ, siwo le dzɔdzɔm le Yerusalem-gbedoxɔa me la fiae. Yehowa wɔ esia to nukumɔ aɖe dzi. Xezekiel gale gaxɔ me kokoko, gake Yehowa na wòkpɔ nusianu, si le edzi yim le gbedoxɔa me la. Eye nusi Xezekiel kpɔ la dzi ŋɔ ŋutɔ!

Yehowa gblɔ na Xezekiel be: ‘Kpɔ ŋunyɔnu, siwo wɔm ameawo le le gbedoxɔa me la ɖa. Kpɔ glia ŋu ɖa; eyɔ fũ kple dawo kple lã bubuwo ƒe nɔnɔmetata. Azɔ kpɔe ɖa, Israel-viwo le wo subɔm!’ Xezekiel te ŋu kpɔ nusiawo katã, eye wòŋlɔ nusi le dzɔdzɔm la ɖi.

Yehowa bia Xezekiel be: ‘Èkpɔ nusi Israel ƒe kpɔlawo le wɔwɔm le vivimea?’ Ẽ, eya hã kpɔ esia. Ŋutsu 70, wo katã le alakpamawuwo subɔm. Wole gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Yehowa mele mía kpɔm o. Egblẽ anyigba la ɖi.’

Emegbe Yehowa tsɔ nyɔnu aɖewo, siwo le gbedoxɔa ƒe dziehe-gbo nu la fia Xezekiel. Wonɔ anyi ɖe afima hele alakpamawu Tamus subɔm. Azɔ kpɔ ŋutsu, siwo le Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ ƒe mɔ nu la ɖa! Woanɔ ame 25. Xezekiel kpɔ wo. Wodze klo do ɖe ɣedzeƒe hele ta dem agu na ɣe!

Yehowa gblɔ be: ‘Amesiawo metsɔ bubu aɖeke nam o. Menye nu vlo ɖeɖeko wɔm wole o, ke wova le ewɔm le nye gbedoxɔ me ke hã!’ Eyata Yehowa do ŋugbe be: ‘Matrɔ nye dziku akɔ ɖe wo dzi. Eye ne wotsrɔ̃ la, mavem o.’ Esi Yehowa tsɔ nusiawo fia Xezekiel megbe anɔ abe ƒe etɔ̃ ko ene ye Israel-viwo dze aglã ɖe Fia Nebukadnezar ŋu. Eyata eho aʋa ɖe wo ŋu. Ƒe ɖeka kple afã megbe la, Babiloniatɔwo mu Yerusalem-gliawo, eye wotɔ dzo du la kolikoli. Wowu ame geɖe hekplɔ ame geɖe yi Babilon abe gamenɔlawo ene.

Nukatae Yehowa na tsɔtrɔ̃ dziŋɔ sia va Israel-viwo dzi? Elabena womeɖo to Yehowa o, eye womewɔ eƒe sewo dzi o. Esia fia be ele vevie be míawɔ nusi Mawu gblɔ la ɣesiaɣi.

Gbã la, woɖe mɔ na ame ʋɛ aɖewo be woanɔ Israel-nyigba la dzi. Fia Nebukadnezar tsɔ Yudatɔ aɖe, si ŋkɔe nye Gedalya la ɖo amesiawo nu. Gake Israel-vi aɖewo wu Gedalya. Fifia ameawo le vɔvɔ̃m be Babiloniatɔwo ava tsrɔ̃ yewo katã le nu vlo, si wowɔ la ta. Eyata wozi Yeremya dzi be wòakplɔ yewo ɖo, eye wosi yi Egipte.

Esia na Israel-nyigba la tsi anyi ƒuƒlu. Ame aɖeke menɔ anyigba la dzi o hena ƒe 70. Etsi ƒuƒlu keŋkeŋ. Gake Yehowa do ŋugbe be le ƒe 70 megbe la, yeakplɔ yeƒe dukɔ agbɔe. Hafi ɣemaɣi naɖo la, nukae le dzɔdzɔm ɖe Mawu ƒe amewo dzi le Babilon-nyigba, si dzi wokplɔ wo yii la dzi? Na míakpɔe ɖa.Fiawo II, 25:1-26; Yeremya 29:10; Xezekiel 1:1-3; 8:1-18. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo
